result.summary: The intersection features a high-visibility zebra crosswalk and basic sidewalk infrastructure in a commercial setting. However, the wide roadway and lack of visible pedestrian-specific signals or refuge islands increase the risk for people crossing.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Exposure
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes and a wide roadway without a median refuge.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the image across the main road.

hazards.name: Missing Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian signal heads are visible at this signalized intersection.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles near the crosswalk may block sight lines between drivers and pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the roadway near the crosswalk.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to reduce the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Add a raised island in the center of the roadway to allow pedestrians to cross in two stages.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signals with countdown timers to provide clear right-of-way information.

result.summary: The intersection features a marked zebra crosswalk and sidewalks on both sides, but lacks dedicated pedestrian signals and curb extensions. Parked vehicles near the corner and faded pavement markings reduce visibility for both pedestrians and drivers.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The zebra markings are significantly worn, reducing their visibility to approaching motorists.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles close to the intersection corner may block the view between pedestrians waiting to cross and oncoming traffic.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Markings
interventions.description: Repaint the crosswalk with high-visibility thermoplastic markings to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions (bulb-outs) to shorten the crossing distance and prevent parking too close to the crosswalk, improving sightlines.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signals with countdown timers to provide clear information on when it is safe to cross.

result.summary: The environment features a wide multi-lane roadway with a high-visibility continental crosswalk and a painted bike lane. While basic pedestrian infrastructure like sidewalks and traffic signals are present, the long crossing distance and lack of a median refuge increase exposure to vehicle traffic.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a mid-block refuge island.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground crosswalk across the main roadway

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles on the left side of the image may obscure pedestrians from oncoming traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the roadway near the parking lot entrance

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten crossing distance and improve visibility.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The intersection features standard pedestrian infrastructure including marked zebra crosswalks, curb ramps, and pedestrian signals. However, the wide roadway and lack of physical medians or refuge islands increase pedestrian exposure time and potential for high-speed vehicle conflicts.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide intersection increases the time pedestrians are exposed to traffic without a safe place to wait mid-crossing.

hazards.name: Wide Turning Radii
hazards.description: The open geometry of the corners allows vehicles to make turns at higher speeds, increasing risk to pedestrians in the crosswalk.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and slow down turning vehicles.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Add a raised median island to provide a safe haven for pedestrians crossing the wide roadway.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Adjust signal timing to give pedestrians a head start before vehicles get a green light.
